content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The trade-specific illustration and clear call button work well, but the closing contact section and oversized footer repeat information and prolong the page unnecessarily.",
  "desktopNote": "The enormous masthead, headings and footer branding overwhelm otherwise clear content and make the page feel inflated rather than carefully proportioned.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the desktop masthead, hero headline and section headings substantially; replace the enormous footer wordmark with compact branding.",
    "Consolidate the closing contact section and footer into one contact area, with legal information and utility links beneath it rather than another address and phone block.",
    "Tighten the phone hero’s gaps around the call button, directions link and radiator illustration so the services section appears sooner."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop: the footer repeats the address and phone block immediately after the closing contact section."
  ]
}
